cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let work ring. I'd like to finish choosing our wedding vows with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The client won't sign unless I'm there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'm about to promise you my whole life. Could I have ten minutes before the client?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask Maya to cover. She'll want a reason.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell her we're making promises too. Put ours in your calendar beside the client's.

mechanism: A professionally enforces completion of wedding-vow work before a competing client demand, using calendar precision to make their connection count as a real commitment.
confusable: D74 keeps someone for repair after practical work ends; D82 asks this connection be prioritised over a competing opportunity or promise.
comparison: Dumpling alternative rejects postponing shared dinner for promotion; vows alternative negotiates cover for a short protected commitment.
seedUse: Wedding vows, ringing work, client signature and Maya cover derive from D82-a; S03 adds completion and calendar-entry corrections.
